Tender Capacity- Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity is ( A x N x 2.5 - B ) where,A is Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2026-27 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N is Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited Ie.,1 months (0.083 years ). B is Value, at 2026-27 price level (updated to the Financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on going works to be completed during the next 30 days (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e.,2021-22 , 2022-23 ,2023-24, 2024-25 ,2025-26 Achieved in at least TWO financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Class of Civil Engineering Construction Works only) of Rs 12.69 Lakhs. (Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).
